text:
Tara (Finance): Flagging an oddity on the reseller split in INV-2028-06-11. Looks like a single CloudChannel order was billed twice across two reseller IDs (reseller-A and reseller-B). Total delta ~ $7,120. We need to fix before close. :confused:

Jae (Billing): Can you paste a sample line? Is it duplicated line items or different SKUs?

Tara (Finance): Sample lines (redacted):
```
Invoice: INV-2028-06-11
Line: marketplace:us-east-1:reseller-A:prod-ml-infer  Units: 10  ChargeUSD: 4,200.00  meter_id: mm-44ab
Line: marketplace:us-east-1:reseller-B:prod-ml-infer  Units: 10  ChargeUSD: 2,920.00  meter_id: mm-44ab
```
Note: same meter_id but different reseller tag. Combined amount 7,120. Looks like a split-pricing rule applied and also the original charge, double-counting for same meter.

Maya (Partner Ops): CloudChannel partners sometimes split charges for seat vs usage and send separate metering records. Did we recently change our split rules?

Dev (Sales): I spoke with reseller-A and reseller-B yesterday; both claim they should get a portion based on channel referral percentages. They say the partner-side metering looked correct.

Ivy (Platform): Quick look at ingestion: our transform has a new "reseller_split" path active since 2028-06-10. It creates an additional synthetic line when partners send a "split_allocation" flag. Seems we didn't dedupe by meter_id in that flow. Log snippet: `INFO transform.split - creating allocation for meter mm-44ab split_pct=41%`

billing-bot: Automated scan: Potential duplicate/reseller-split exposure detected on INV-2028-06-11. Suspect double-counting across split transform. Unallocated discrepancy = $7,120. Suggested actions: 1) run dedupe reprocess 2) if not possible before close, post temporary clearing journal. Link: https://billing.internal/recon/INV-2028-06-11

Jae (Billing): If Platform can reprocess with dedupe by meter_id and flag=split, that should remove the duplicate. Ivy, can you re-run transform for 06-09 -> 06-11 and apply meter_id dedupe? ETA?

Ivy (Platform): I can patch the transform to skip creating synthetic split lines when the original meter_id exists elsewhere. Small change, unit test, then reprocess. ETA ~3 hours (need staging run and VERIFY).

Tara (Finance): We have a close window in ~6 hours. If reprocess completes before then we avoid manual journals. If not, approve interim clearing journal?

Dev (Sales): Resellers asked for us to proceed quickly; they prefer corrected invoice rather than a manual offset. But they understand month-end constraints.

Maya (Partner Ops): I'll ask both resellers to freeze any downstream allocations until we confirm. Also collecting their metering exports to cross-check.

Jae (Billing): Approve temporary manual clearing journal up to $8k only if reprocess not done by 2028-06-12 02:00 UTC. Tara, please confirm sign-off threshold.

Tara (Finance): Approved. Temporary journal allowed up to $8,000. Tag as "mp-split-temp" and reference INV-2028-06-11.

Ivy (Platform): Patch merged. Starting reprocess job rp-dedupe-110. Will post results.

billing-bot: Reprocess job rp-dedupe-110 started. Monitoring link: https://billing.internal/jobs/rp-dedupe-110

billing-bot: Reprocess complete. Results: deduped 1 duplicated meter (mm-44ab). New allocation: reseller-A 4,200.00, reseller-B 2,920.00 remains but original duplicate removed -> net correction applied: -4,200.00 removed. Remaining discrepancy after reprocess = $0.00. Reconciliation link: https://billing.internal/recon/INV-2028-06-11/rp-dedupe-110

Jae (Billing): Verified updated invoice lines and ledger mapping. No manual journal required. Moving invoice to reconciled.

Dev (Sales): Confirmed with reseller-A and reseller-B; both see corrected splits on their statements. Reseller-B appreciated the quick turnaround.

Tara (Finance): Great work. Ivy, can you add a runbook entry for the split transform: dedupe by meter_id and steps for emergency reprocess? Also add an alert when synthetic split lines exceed 1% of invoice total.

Ivy (Platform): Will add runbook note and a Prometheus alert for split anomaly. I'll also add a postmortem blurb to the engineering ops doc.

Maya (Partner Ops): Adding a partner guidance note: when partners send split_allocation flag, include original_meter_id and split_pct to avoid ambiguity. I'll push this to partner integration checklist.

Tara (Finance): Thanks team. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
